title: Submitting a request sometimes fails with a server error
body: Two students reported an 'Internal Server Error' after pressing Submit. Trying again usually works. It seems to happen more in busy weeks.

title: Express requests are overcharged
body: A student ordered 3 express transcripts and was charged ₦22,500. By the 2023 circular in CONTRIBUTING.md it should be less. Bulk orders may be affected too.

title: Admin list never shows the last page
body: With 25 requests the admin list says 'Page 1 of 2' and the last 5 requests can never be reached.

title: Copies field accepts nonsense
body: Typing `two` in Copies crashes the form. Typing `0` or `-3` is accepted and produces a ₦0 or negative fee.

title: Submission dates sort wrongly and ignore time zones
body: Dates are stored like `09/11/2026 14:05`, so sorting by date puts 10 January after 09 November. The server clock is also not in Lagos time.

title: Track page is slow for some references
body:
Tracking REQ-2026-4471 takes several seconds on the Registry PC.
